note: P(plays next team game | has missed k straight), top-150 players 2021-24 (research/hazard_refit.py). Each player's last stint is observed to his team's 15th-to-last game, so absences that never ended (season-ending injuries) are censored without counting end-of-season shutdowns; absences with a coach's-decision, rest, personal, suspension, health-and-safety protocol or reconditioning entry are dropped (not injuries).

designation._source: isheplayingtonight.com/nba-injuries/questionable-play-rate: published summary table (first official-report designation vs minutes played, 2,007 player-games, Jan-Oct 2026), read once by hand; no scraper. Per-category n: Probable 351, Questionable 1,367, Doubtful 289.

healthy_curve._source: 2021-24 box-score panel, top-100 players: P(plays a non-b2b team game N games after a game he played); n=16,500 at N=1

_b2b_source: same panel: b2b/non-b2b play-rate ratio 0.931-0.943 at every horizon (research/out2.txt: miss 13.9% -> 19.8%, 0.802/0.861)
_hazard_source: research/hazard_refit.py (review 2, finding 5): protocol/reconditioning stays dropped, last stint observed to the team's 15th-to-last game (end-of-season shutdowns censored). 13-20 (0.114, n=273) and 21+ (0.138, n=65) don't differ (se 0.047), so 13+ is pooled: 0.118.
